strique.io

Building Strique's Agentic Marketing OS across product, platform, analytics, and applied AI.

  • Took features from Next.js screens through Python services and MCP connectors, working across frontend and backend.
  • Reworked onboarding to generate Brand DNA in the background and inject persistent brand context into AI agents.
  • Instrumented key user journeys with PostHog, added production error tracking, and built Meta CAPI delivery diagnostics.
  • Worked with marketers to turn Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, and Merchant Center workflows into production agents.
  • Built MCP integrations connecting agents with live marketing platforms and business data.
  • Added approval flows, evidence checks, and failure tracking to make campaign and analytics agents safer in production.
